messages.subject: Over-parameterized 2PL model
parts:
Dear Phil (and MIRT users), 

Thank you for a wonderful package and for this forum. I am having an issue with a non-parametric 1 dimensional IRT model I am fitting with a large size dataset using a large cohort study, sample with complete data for all variables and survey weights N=9245. 
When assessing goodness of fit my model has negative degrees of freedom with no RMSEA estimation showing over-parameterized (over-fit model). How can I address this? I am at a loss as to why this is happening.

Thank you, 

Zain

modmfV2 <- mirt(MF2MIRT1,
+                 1,
+                 itemtype = '2PL',
+                 SE = FALSE,
+                 covdata = NULL,
+                 formula = NULL,
+                 SE.type = "Fisher",
+                 method = "EM",
+                 optimizer = NULL,
+                 dentype = "EHW",
+                 zeroExtreme = TRUE,
+                 technical = list (symmetric = FALSE),
+                 survey.weights = BOVWT2,
+                 pars = NULL,
+                 verbose = TRUE)

summary(modmfV2) #Factor solution
                  F1       h2

F1  1

That does seem a little strange to me as the df is not based on anything other than the number of parameters and first/second order moments. Could you provide a reprex of this?

Phil
